system.description:
You hold your hands out and Fire a sheet of flame from your hands. Each creature in a 20-foot cone must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 3d6+3 Fire damage and gain a rank of Shaken on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and increase the damage by 1d6+1. If this jutsu is cast at C-Rank or higher, creatures who fail their save also gain +1 rank of Burned. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, this jutsu’s range increases to a 40-foot cone. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, increase the ranks of Burned inflicted to +2, instead of +1. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, this jutsu’s range increases to a 60-foot cone and any creature reduced to 0 as a result of this jutsu’s damage is turned to ash from the intensity of the flames.
